title: Provide a profile-matched operator role-evaluation bundle
goal: Let the owner launch bounded NERV-specific role checks with explicit common-profile settings and saved reviewable evidence
acceptance: One documented operator command selects explicit model/runtime/context/output/sampling/thinking settings and machine/load scenario for synthetic Casper/Misato cases
Preflight and execution preserve a reviewed aggregate time/call/output budget; reject unsupported settings rather than silently inheriting defaults
Save requested/actual configuration, source/case identities, partial/failure outcomes and telemetry gaps to new private reports; no proposed tool executes
Keep common smoke reuse distinct from NERV role/system acceptance; do not duplicate a campaign or claim qualification
Keep reusable protocol behavior upstream and NERV role adapters/configuration here
privacy: Neutral synthetic cases and new private local reports only; no secrets, downloads, production effects or automatic cloud fallback. No live campaign as part of implementing the operator workflow.
validation: Regression fixtures verify exact settings, aggregate-budget stop, interruption and report identity across the evaluator/provider join
Documented command plans and shell syntax validate without real-model execution; final applicable CI
escalation: Native evals:model currently inherits production defaults and has no shared300s aggregate cap; do not present it as profile-matched until implemented
Owner reviews any additional live campaign scope/budget; preparation itself runs no models
External project references are conditional alternatives, not required dependencies

effort.basis: Estimate added at featurePlans adoption (2026-11-11): Profile-matched operator role bundle; earlier record estimate Small for T04 alone. Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 1.5 hours agent; former 1-day estimate at 1.5 agent hours per focused day. Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, not a calculation, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h by quantile method, p90 about 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI, while an agent part that only prepares or records for an owner step may be less. Machine time of real-model or device runs is not counted. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 1 kept as history. Re-estimated 2026-11-12 at 0.6x from `work-items calibrate` (median 0.55x over 6 closed steps; bug steps 0.6x over 5): 1.5 h → 1 h, min 0.5 h; owner hours and baseline kept. Estimate column backfilled 2026-11-12 at harness 7.0.0: estimateAgentHours = remaining plus actual so far (1 h); the baseline stays for calibration.
